status_at_creation: pre-registered before any economic result of this experiment was computed
purpose: On official Polymarket outcomes in development F1+F2, does the E0051 any-sequence n=5 model (32 classes, per-leg marginals) give a better net result than the n=1 single-candle model at the same time and price, and does earlier pre-open entry with the same forecast exploit 0.50-0.51 prices? Each market is bought pre-start with own cash and settled independently; any UP/DOWN combination and skipping any leg is allowed. Historical development research only; no holdout, no live model/config.

source_experiment.replay: E0052 replay (commit ccf37e2): saved F1/F2 model.txt (SHA-256 checked against task.json) re-applied without refit to every decision slot of its own stage with the stored E0051 feature matrices; equality with saved predictions.parquet on common rows is required (max abs diff <= 1e-9). H models, holdout features, labels and predictions are never opened.

clocks.feature_last_source: close of the 1m candle ending at anchor T-60s (nominal E0051 contract)
clocks.forecast_ready: T-60s nominal; historical receipt of the complete 1m candle and model completion time are UNCONFIRMED, so all results are diagnostic on the nominal clock
clocks.book_observation: entry time t_e: book state after all archive events with receive timestamp <= t_e (no later receive event accepted)
clocks.order_submit: t_e - 1s (order delay 1s, as in the T-59 product: decision S-60s, entry S-59s)
clocks.fill: simulated immediately at t_e from the observed snapshot (taker) or from post-placement prints (passive bounds)
clocks.requirement: forecast_ready <= order_submit; book and fee data received <= t_e

forecasts.n1: P(UP) = p1 of the n=1 model at decision S-60s for target S
forecasts.n5_leg: anchor T, legs T_j = T + 5j min (j=0..4); P(UP_j) = sum of class probabilities with bit j set; P(DOWN_j) = 1 - P(UP_j); E0051 coding c = sum_k y_k 2^k, first market = least significant bit (verified against official targets)
forecasts.raw_only: raw uncalibrated vectors in all main comparisons; no calibrated variant is fitted
forecasts.horizons: for target S and horizon j the only anchor is T = S - 5j min; forecast is nominally 1, 6, 11, 16, 21 minutes old at S (ready T-60s)
forecasts.fold_assignment: by forecast-ready time = stage of the anchor slot T; a (target, j) pair is kept only when the anchor stage equals the target stage and is F1 or F2 (C0->F1 and F1->F2 cross-boundary anchors are dropped and counted); models and generators are audited to have training/fit cutoffs <= forecast-ready time
forecasts.multi_horizon_portfolio: not reported; each policy uses one fixed horizon j, so a market appears at most once per policy (uniqueness asserted)

evaluation_labels: official Polymarket outcome of the target present, outcome_available_at known and < development cutoff (E0051 export, nominal availability rule = proxy, marked); labels are used only for scoring

prediction_metrics.sequence: n=5 windows under the E0052 rule (complete official 5-sequence, all starts < fold end, label availability < cutoff): 32-class log loss, argmax exact-sequence hit rate split by mixed vs one-direction predicted class, vs E0051 causal global and conditional benchmarks (fitted at fold start - 60s) on the same windows and vs 1/32
prediction_metrics.leg: Brier score and log loss of P(UP) for n1 and each n5 horizon on the common leg pool; calibration (deciles of P(chosen side)) on legs actually traded by the main rule

execution.size_note: $5 order notional per market for every policy (matches the earlier $5 depth diagnostic); taker fee is added in cash in the cash-collateral regime, so cash debit slightly exceeds $5
execution.fill_rule: walk ask levels with price <= limit for $5 notional; full fill required (FOK-like); otherwise no execution

fees.rule: date-assigned taker fee shares*rate*p*(1-p) (rate 0.07 from 2026-05-06 estimate), cash-collateral collection; makers pay no fee (taker_only); applied through run_btc_preopen_economic_replay._walk_asks
fees.observed_fee_event_note: the dated registry assigns the fee; presence of an archived fee_rate_bps event before entry is reported only as a diagnostic

execution.side_choice: for each side with full fill within the limit: effective cost = cash debit / net payout shares; edge = P(side) - effective cost; choose the side with the highest edge > margin; exact edge tie -> skip
execution.order_vs_fill: order = a side whose best ask <= limit has P(side) - (best ask + taker fee per share at best ask) > margin; execution = full fill with edge > margin on the walked cost; an order without execution is a killed FOK
quote_validity_per_side: native book of that token initialized (complement-only books are not executable)
archive hour of the entry time available and no missing archive hour between the side's last book snapshot and entry
no event received after entry used; no ambiguous equal-source-timestamp ask order; bid/ask not crossed
execution.market_complete_data: both sides valid at the entry time (a policy can only choose a side when both are priced); otherwise the opportunity is 'no execution data' and stays missing, distinct from an eligible no-trade (PnL 0)
execution.minimum_order: current Gamma order_min_size_shares (audit context); $5 at <= 0.51 always exceeds 5 shares
execution.pnl: per bought leg: net payout shares * 1{chosen side = official outcome} - cash debit; every leg settles independently; ROI = sum PnL / sum cash debit
execution.concurrency: per policy, maximum capital simultaneously committed from entry to nominal label availability (nominal status)

entry_times.main: S - 59s for every policy (existing T-59 product; replayed and checked for equality)
entry_times.earlier: S - 5, 10, 15, 20 min, only where the forecast is ready: n5 horizon j allows S - k min for k <= 5j (same forecast as at S - 59s)
entry_times.earlier_comparison: each earlier point vs S - 59s on the common mask of markets with complete data at both times; plus practical comparison of the earlier n5 policy vs the later n1 policy at S - 59s

passive_variant.status: conservative execution bounds from L2 book + public prints; queue priority is not identified (no order ids)
passive_variant.placement: post-only bid at the limit on the chosen side at S - k min (k = 5, 10, 15, 20, forecast ready), size $5 / limit shares; if the token's best ask <= limit at placement the post-only order is rejected (counted)
passive_variant.side_choice: highest P(side) - limit > margin (maker fee 0); tie -> skip
passive_variant.cancel: order is cancelled for prints received after S - 5s (cancel effective before start including latency)
passive_variant.lower_bound: queue ahead = displayed bid size at exactly the limit on that token at placement; fill = min(order, max(0, SELL-taker print size at exactly the limit on that token after placement - queue ahead)); any print on the token below the limit -> full fill
passive_variant.upper_bound: full fill if any print on the token at <= limit or on the complementary token at >= 1 - limit after placement; otherwise 0
passive_variant.pnl: filled shares * 1{win} - filled shares * limit; partial and zero fills recorded

comparisons: n5 j=0 vs n1 at S-59s (same market, feature cutoff, snapshot, rules, budget)
n5 j=1..4 vs n1 at the target's S-59s (each horizon separately)
n5 j at S-k min vs the same n5 j at S-59s (same forecast)
n5 j at S-k min vs n1 at S-59s (practical)

uncertainty.method: paired common-block circular moving-block bootstrap over UTC days of the difference in PnL per common opportunity (sum of differences / number of common opportunities)

rolling_payout: separate feasibility control only: check whether an archived funds-availability time and a book for the next purchasable market exist; report nominal minimum gaps from resolution metadata; the sum of separately bought legs or the product of prices is never used as a rolling realisation

data_sources.holdout_guard: event-part hour files >= 2026-07-01T00 are never opened; ladder and Gamma reads are filtered to market_start_utc < 2026-07-01
